mapper.select: SELECT r.REPEAT_RULE_CODE AS REPEAT_SCHEDULE_CODE, r.CLASS_CODE, r.OPERATION_START_DATE AS REPEAT_START_DATE, r.OPERATION_END_DATE AS REPEAT_END_DATE FROM CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r WHERE r.CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} ORDER BY r.OPERATION_START_DATE, r.REPEAT_RULE_CODE

SELECT s.SCHEDULE_CODE, r.CLASS_CODE, s.REPEAT_RULE_CODE, s.CLASS_DATE AS SCHEDULE_DATE, s.START_TIME, s.END_TIME, s.MIN_PEOPLE, s.MAX_PEOPLE, CASE WHEN TRUNC(s.CLASS_DATE) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN '진행 완료' WHEN s.SOLD_OUT_YN = 'Y' THEN '모집 마감' ELSE '모집중' END AS SCHEDULE_STATUS FROM SCHEDULE s JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r ON r.REPEAT_RULE_CODE = s.REPEAT_RULE_CODE WHERE r.CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} ORDER BY s.CLASS_DATE, s.START_TIME, s.SCHEDULE_CODE
mapper.sql: s.SCHEDULE_CODE, r.CLASS_CODE, s.CLASS_DATE AS SCHEDULE_DATE, s.START_TIME, s.END_TIME, s.MIN_PEOPLE, s.MAX_PEOPLE, NVL(( SELECT SUM(rv.PEOPLE_NUMBER) FROM RESERVATION rv WHERE rv.SCHEDULE_CODE = s.SCHEDULE_CODE AND rv.STATUS = '예약' ), 0) AS RESERVED_COUNT, s.REMAINING_PEOPLE, CASE WHEN TRUNC(s.CLASS_DATE) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN '진행 완료' WHEN s.SOLD_OUT_YN = 'Y' OR s.REMAINING_PEOPLE = 0 THEN '모집 마감' ELSE '모집중' END AS SCHEDULE_STATUS

mapper.update: UPDATE SCHEDULE s SET s.REMAINING_PEOPLE = #{remainingPeople}, s.SOLD_OUT_YN = CASE WHEN #{remainingPeople} = 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END WHERE s.SCHEDULE_CODE = #{scheduleCode} AND TRUNC(s.CLASS_DATE) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r JOIN CLASS c ON c.CLASS_CODE = r.CLASS_CODE WHERE r.REPEAT_RULE_CODE = s.REPEAT_RULE_CODE AND c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND c.APPROVAL_STATUS = '승인' AND c.STATUS IN ('모집중', '준비중') ) AND #{remainingPeople} BETWEEN 0 AND ( s.MAX_PEOPLE - NVL(( SELECT SUM(rv.PEOPLE_NUMBER) FROM RESERVATION rv WHERE rv.SCHEDULE_CODE = s.SCHEDULE_CODE AND rv.STATUS = '예약' ), 0) )

UPDATE SCHEDULE s SET REMAINING_PEOPLE = 0, SOLD_OUT_YN = 'Y' WHERE s.SCHEDULE_CODE = #{scheduleCode} AND TRUNC(s.CLASS_DATE) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r JOIN CLASS c ON c.CLASS_CODE = r.CLASS_CODE WHERE r.REPEAT_RULE_CODE = s.REPEAT_RULE_CODE AND c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND c.APPROVAL_STATUS = '승인' AND c.STATUS IN ('모집중', '준비중') )

SELECT (SELECT NVL(MAX(SCHEDULE_CODE), 0) FROM SCHEDULE) + SEQ_SCHEDULE_CODE.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SCHEDULE ( SCHEDULE_CODE, REPEAT_RULE_CODE, CLASS_DATE, START_TIME, END_TIME, MIN_PEOPLE, MAX_PEOPLE, REMAINING_PEOPLE, SOLD_OUT_YN ) VALUES ( #{scheduleCode}, #{repeatRuleCode}, #{scheduleDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{minPeople}, #{maxPeople}, #{maxPeople}, 'N' )
